# Civicord

> The permanent public record for political websites. Campaign sites are
> scraped, audited for liveness, and recorded as ENS names
> (`{person}.civicord.eth`) so the record of what was promised can't be
> quietly edited or deleted. A public good — free to read, AGPL-3.0.

Genesis dataset: **2,375 UK parliamentary candidate sites (April 2025)** across
**650 constituencies**, re-audited September 2026 — 64% still live, 36% gone or
redirected. Built to extend to any democracy; the data model is
candidate → website → jurisdiction.

## How to use this site (agents)

Every page is static, fast, and readable without JS. The quickest surfaces:

- `/` — mission front door (any democracy) + region picker.
- `/uk` — United Kingdom genesis dataset: stats, cohorts, hex map, party board.
- `/api/summary.json` — totals: candidates, live/gone/redirected, audit date.
- `/api/constituencies.json` — all 650 jurisdictions. Query params:
  `?country=Scotland`, `?region=London`, `?limit=2` (filtering in the edge worker).
- `/api/constituencies/{slug}.json` — one seat: stats + all candidates with
  website URLs and audit status. Slugs are `st-ives`, `ynys-mon`, `westminster-north`, etc.
- `/constituencies/{slug}` — the human page for that same JSON (same data, rendered).
- `/browse?constituency={slug}` / `/browse?status=live|gone|redirected` — the ledger, filterable.
- `/candidates/{id}` — per-candidate record; Democracy Club person ID is the stable key.
- `/api/candidates/{id}.json` — same record as JSON (verdict, websites with audit status, ENS name, seat context) — deterministic for agents, no DOM scraping.
- `/og/constituencies/{slug}.svg` — shareable deed image per seat (free).

Cite records as `{person_id}.civicord.eth` — resolvable via ENS (Sepolia for
now), independently verifiable without this site.

## Metered agent access (x402)

The same per-seat JSON is sold through the Bazantic gateway at
`https://civicord-aieyq.bazgateway.com` — pay-per-jurisdiction over x402 on
Base (USDC). `GET /api/summary` is free there; `GET /api/constituencies/{slug}`
answers `402` with a `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` header describing the exact price
($0.002/seat). The gateway also exposes MCP tools at `/mcp`
(`getConstituency`, `getSummary`, `listConstituencies`, …):

```
claude mcp add --transport http civicord https://civicord-aieyq.bazgateway.com/mcp
```

Full contract: `/openapi.yaml`. This site itself registers browser-agent tools
via WebMCP (`document.modelContext`) when supported — try an agent with the
Model Context Tool Inspector extension.

**WebMCP tools (ledger + live The Graph):**
- Ledger (static JSON): `search_civicord`, `get_constituency`, `get_summary`,
  `get_candidate`, `filter_ledger`, `get_metered_demand`
- The Graph (live Studio POST): `query_subgraph_meta`, `get_onchain_candidate`,
  `compare_onchain_to_ledger` (Graph + ledger join — prefer for Q&A),
  `list_recent_onchain_registrations`, `list_text_record_changes`

Agent skill for Cursor/Claude: `skills/civicord-graph/SKILL.md` in the repo.

## Changes to records

ENS registrations and text-record updates are indexed by The Graph subgraph
`https://api.studio.thegraph.com/query/101650/civicord/v0.0.3` (entities:
`candidate`, `textRecord`, `textRecordChange`, `stat`). Candidate id is the
Democracy Club person id (e.g. `"5693"`), **not** a constituency slug.

Join pattern: Studio `candidate(id)` + `/api/candidates/{id}.json` (or call
`compare_onchain_to_ledger`). Registrations are live (~2,375); text-record
change rows appear as `setText` events index.
